text:
maya: Heads-up — we have a FlowBridge marketplace connector coming through. Need a quick SSO + legal compatibility preflight before we greenlight listing. Can we do a 30m sync tomorrow 10am PT?

sam: 10am works for me. Quick Q: their auth stack is OIDC primary, but they also support SAML. Do we require both for marketplace?@maya

lee: For legal: we'll need their signed DPA and confirmation of logging retention limits. Also ask for a completed security questionnaire (standard infosec form). NDA only if they're requesting technical docs.

nina: For product/announce: we need an embargo timeline and joint quote if this is a co-announce. Also confirm support model (partner handles first-tier or we do).

arjun: From integration side — main checklist items: SSO type (OIDC/SAML), SCIM provisioning support, cert rotation policy, redirect URI allowlist, postman collection for smoke tests. I'll prep a minimal test harness.

sam: For OIDC: we need their issuer, client registration flow (dynamic or manual), allowed scopes. If they have SAML, send metadata XML. Can we require SCIM v2?

maya: Action items: maya -> coordinate docs + invite; sam -> verify SSO compatibility matrix; lee -> list legal deliverables; arjun -> test harness + smoke plan; nina -> announce / embargo window ask. Meeting tomorrow will confirm owners. :white_check_mark:

integrations-bot: Related doc: https://intranet.redwood/partners/sso-checklist (internal) — please attach FlowBridge answers there before meeting.

arjun: Example OIDC snippet I'll ask them to provide in thread (helps automation):

```
issuer: https://auth.flowbridge.example
client_id: <client-id>
redirect_uris:
  - https://console.redwood.ai/oauth/callback
scopes: [openid, profile, email]
```

lee: Also ask for data residency constraints and whether they export logs off-platform. That determines DPA clauses.

nina: If partner is okay with joint quote, marketing wants 2 weeks lead time. Please flag any legal blockers asap.

sam: Noted. I'll draft the SSO compatibility matrix template and paste before the meeting.

maya: Thanks — I'll send the invite and include the doc + placeholders. Please add any items to the checklist page. Meeting invite going out now. :handshake:
